name: lesser-boon-of-shou-enlighten-on-play
notes: Engine fix coverage: playCardAbilities["rSIXf50oBc:0"] was unreachable before bf25c65c for the same reason as qtzsekkjn3 (see vainglory-retribution-play-card-trigger). Playing this card also exposed a second, independent bug: Lesser Boon of Shou's CardType() is "LESSER BOON", which OnCardActivated()'s zone-resolution chain (ALLY/WEAPON/REGALIA/DOMAIN/ITEM/ACTION/ATTACK) never matched, so the card's own EffectStack entry was never moved off the stack. PostResolutionCheck kept finding the stack non-empty and re-resolved the same still-live entry through OnCardActivated() again, re-queuing a fresh PLAY_CARD trigger each time -- an unbounded loop (confirmed live: 100,000+ re-fires before being killed). Fixed by adding a LESSER BOON/GREATER BOON branch to OnCardActivated() (GameLogic.php) that moves Boon cards to the field like items/domains, matching how their persistent field presence is already read elsewhere (e.g. the end-phase enlighten-counter check for this same CardID).

rulesClauses: As this card is played, put an enlighten counter on your champion.
